name: Kumm Curry
steps: Grind coconut, cumin and garlic with 100 ml water to a smooth paste. Wipe mushrooms clean and slice thickly so they stay substantial in the gravy.
Heat oil in a wide pan. Fry curry leaves, dried red chilies and crushed peppercorns for 30 seconds, then add onions and green chilies. Cook for 7 minutes until the onions turn golden.
Add mushrooms and cook uncovered for 5 minutes, stirring until they release moisture and shrink. Do not add extra water at this stage.
Stir in the coconut paste, chopped tomatoes, crushed coriander, turmeric and salt. Cook for 5 minutes until the raw coconut aroma fades and the tomatoes soften.
Add the remaining 100 ml water and simmer for 6 minutes until the peppery coconut gravy coats the mushrooms. Taste, adjust salt and serve with rice or parotta.
tips: This Kodava curry is peppery and coconut-rich; keep the mushrooms thickly cut so they do not disappear in the sauce.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
